name: What is the typical cost for rotted window frame replacement in Daly City?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost for rotted window frame replacement in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of rotted window frame replacement in areas like Daly City varies significantly based on several factors. These include the extent of the rot, the type and size of the window, the material chosen for the new frame (e.g., wood, vinyl, fiberglass), and labor costs. Minor repairs might be a few hundred dollars, while a full frame replacement for a single window could range from $500 to over $1,500, not including the window unit itself if that also needs replacing. Getting a detailed estimate from a local contractor is recommended.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely in Daly City based on rot extent, window type, frame material, and labor. Estimates can range from hundreds for minor repairs to over $1,500 for a full frame replacement.
